desc: Midwest Industries' latest innovation, a fresh look to your favorite lever action rifle! MI's Lever Stocks feature an adjustable polymer cheek piece allowing the use of iron sights, red dots, or magnified optics. The exclusive Midwest Industries butt pad reduces felt recoil while maintaining a secure fit in your shoulder allowing you to maintain complete control under recoil. The Lever Stock also features several properly placed anti-rotation QD swivel sockets, MI also incorporated one standard sling swivel location and stud for versatile sling placement. The MI designed grip panels give a unique look while providing ample texture if in a rainy or snowy environment while provides factory length of pull to fit most users. The Lever Stock does not add weight over factory wood stocks while the grip and stock beam made from 6061 hardcoat anodized aluminum. Like all Midwest Industries products, the are made in the U.S.A.!
